# Small House Plan - 3 Bedroom
# Approx 10.8m x 8.4m

GRID X A=0 B=3600 C=7200 D=10800
GRID Y 1=0 2=4200 3=8400

LEVEL Ground=0

# External walls
WALL A1-B1 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL B1-C1 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL C1-D1 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL D1-D2 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL D2-D3 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL D3-C3 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL C3-B3 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL B3-A3 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL A3-A2 thickness=110 height=2700
WALL A2-A1 thickness=110 height=2700

# Internal walls
WALL B1-B2 thickness=90 height=2700
WALL C1-C2 thickness=90 height=2700
WALL B2-C2 thickness=90 height=2700
WALL A2-B2 thickness=90 height=2700
WALL C2-D2 thickness=90 height=2700

# Doors
DOOR A1-B1 offset=900 width=820 height=2040
DOOR B1-C1 offset=1400 width=820 height=2040
DOOR B1-B2 offset=1600 width=820 height=2040
DOOR C1-C2 offset=1600 width=820 height=2040
DOOR A2-B2 offset=900 width=820 height=2040
DOOR C2-D2 offset=900 width=820 height=2040
DOOR B2-C2 offset=1400 width=920 height=2040

# Windows
WINDOW A2-A1 offset=1200 width=1800 height=1200 sill=900
WINDOW D1-D2 offset=1200 width=1800 height=1200 sill=900
WINDOW D2-D3 offset=1200 width=1800 height=1200 sill=900
WINDOW B3-A3 offset=900 width=1800 height=1200 sill=900
WINDOW D3-C3 offset=900 width=1800 height=1200 sill=900

# Rooms
ROOM "Bedroom 1" walls=A1-B1,B1-B2,B2-A2,A2-A1 level=Ground
ROOM "Bedroom 2" walls=B1-C1,C1-C2,C2-B2,B1-B2 level=Ground
ROOM "Bedroom 3" walls=C1-D1,D1-D2,D2-C2,C1-C2 level=Ground
ROOM "Living" walls=A2-B2,B2-C2,C3-B3,B3-A3,A3-A2 level=Ground
ROOM "Kitchen" walls=C2-D2,D2-D3,D3-C3,C3-B3 level=Ground

# Dimensions
DIM A1-B1-C1-D1 offset=800
DIM A1-A2-A3 offset=800
DIM D1-D2-D3 offset=800
